tools.name: search_threads
tools.description: Lists email threads matching a Gmail query (from:, newer_than:, after:YYYY/MM/DD, subject:, OR, -, ...). Returns thread ids with each message's id, sender, subject, snippet and date. Full bodies need get_thread.

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: Retrieves an email thread with its messages. messageFormat PLAIN_TEXT returns each message's id, sender, subject, date and plaintext_body.
